nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 20 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations updated at 03:08 and 01:57 WAT on 23 Nov, independently rechecked at 08:08 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
